mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (account_id, stock_code, side, order_type, quantity, limit_price, filled_price, filled_quantity, total_amount, status, cancel_of_order_id, ordered_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{stockCode}, #{side}, #{orderType}, #{quantity}, #{limitPrice, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{filledPrice}, #{filledQuantity}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{cancelOfOrderId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{orderedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, stock_code, side, order_type, quantity, limit_price, filled_price, filled_quantity, total_amount, status, cancel_of_order_id, ordered_at FROM orders WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY ordered_at DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT id, account_id, stock_code, side, order_type, quantity, limit_price, filled_price, filled_quantity, total_amount, status, cancel_of_order_id, ordered_at FROM orders WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND stock_code = #{stockCode} ORDER BY ordered_at DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
